description: Get available consultation times with The2410 for the current software project. Use this tool when the user wants to speak with The2410 or choose a consultation time. The tool retrieves current calendar availability and returns up to ten slots, ordered from earliest to latest, in the requested timezone. This tool does not reserve a slot or create a booking.

date_from.description: First date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the requested timezone. Defaults to today.

date_to.description: Last date, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to six days after date_from. Maximum query span: 31 days.

project_context_id.description: The exact project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, for example Europe/Berlin. Defaults to Europe/Riga.

name: get_consultation_slots
title: Get consultation slots
